@graph.name: Three steps, starting with your distributor
@graph.description: Nothing gets installed on a computer, and most of the setup is done by your distributor.

step.name: Ask which distributor has it
step.text: If they offer VoiceOrder Solutions, they open an account for your kitchen and load its guide. Not sure which one? Ask us.

step.name: Put it on your phone
step.text: Install it on an iPhone or Android phone, sign in, and the guide is there.

step.name: Speak the reorder and send it
step.text: Talk through the order, look it over, then tap send.

@graph.name: Do I need a Craftable alternative to speak my orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Craftable runs a group's back office from the first order to the paid bill. If a supplier you phone or message today has our app, you can speak that reorder there instead.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Craftable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at approvals, budgets, inventory, invoices, payments or reporting: we do none of those. Our job is smaller: a reorder you speak to a distributor and check before it goes. If slow reordering is the reason for your Craftable alternative search, that one job may be all you need beside it.

@graph.name: Will an order from your app show up in Craftable?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The two products do not connect, nothing is shared between them, and each team supports its own software only. An order given in our app goes to your distributor and is never created as a Craftable purchase order.

@graph.name: Do orders I speak go through Craftable's approvals?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They go straight to the distributor, so Craftable's approvals and invoice matching never see them. Craftable's budget does not see that order when you place it. Where sign-off matters, leave that distributor's orders in Craftable.

@graph.name: Can I reach all my vendors this way?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the distributors who run VoiceOrder Solutions for their accounts. Craftable gets an order to any vendor with an email address or phone number, and we cannot. Use Craftable for all other vendors, and ask your distributors whether they have our app.

@graph.name: What if I say 12 cases and the review screen shows 2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every line shows on screen before it goes, so correct the number there or delete the line. Your review is the safeguard, and a hurried look can still let an error through. An order you phone in or leave on voicemail gets no order number from us; only orders sent in the app get one.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The distributor handles setup. Once your account is added, your guide is in the app, and most first orders go in that same day. If yours does not offer it, or you are not sure, message us and we will find whoever can help. Cost is a question for your distributor, because you get the app from them, and we post no price list. Craftable quotes its prices rather than publishing them.

@graph.name: Where do the Craftable details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gathered from craftable.com and its help center on 27 October 2026: the platform and ordering pages, the help articles on placing orders, and their press releases. We leave out the operator totals and savings Craftable quotes about itself. If Craftable has changed something since then, tell us and we will fix the page.
